claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Bumetanide is a loop diuretic NKCC1/NKCC2 (SLC12A) inhibitor that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would likely reflect weak, non-selective off-target activity rather than a bona fide cytotoxic mechanism.
